data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Networked Workflow DAG Token Allocation — Adjoint Shadow Values, Upstream Planning Leverage, and Risk-Aware Optimization
data.description: Authoritative mathematical and architectural specification for optimal token allocation across networked multi-agent workflow DAGs on Google Cloud ADK 2.0 — deriving reverse-topological adjoint shadow values (mu_w), KKT first-order optimality conditions, Zhu (2026) Section 6 quantitative case studies (Sequential Interpretation Bottlenecks, 6.15x Reasoning vs. RAG Retrieval Leverage, and 21.4% Planner vs. Executor Elasticity), and the 4-Channel Risk-Aware Token Allocation functional.
